name: ECON 2101W
title: Economic History of Europe
description: Economic evolution of Europe from feudal times to the present, emphasizing the modern period: the rise of commerce, industry, and banking; the growth of population and the labor force; the changing position of agriculture; business fluctuations; and forms of economic organization. CA 1.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; ECON 1200 or both ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) and ECON 1202; ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) may be taken concurrently.
